notes.text: We've ensured that new drafts are discarded correctly when navigating back from the object page
We've now ensured that inline creation row errors are displayed only when focus leaves the row
You can now use the UI.PresentationVariant/GroupBy annotation to automatically group values in value help
We now support ALT+CTRL+N as a global Create shortcut and CTRL+Enter as a global Go shortcut on the list report page and the analytical list page
We now support inline row creation in editable analytical tables with active grouping
We've introduced AddViaValueHelp, a new table creation mode that lets users add existing rows to a table through the MDC value help dialog and remove them without a confirmation prompt
We now scroll the focused table row back into view after a column-resize animation
We now ensure that navigation context data is cached before draft dialogs are displayed
We've resolved an issue where intent-based navigation used an incorrect value for fields with TextOnly text arrangement in header facets
